entries.title: Job 35:2
segments: Do you think this to [be] right, you [that] say, I am more just than God?

entries.title: Job 35:3
segments: For you say, What will it benefit you? And, What good shall I have more than [if] I had sinned?

entries.title: Job 35:4
segments: I will answer your words, and your friends with you.

entries.title: Job 35:5
segments: Look to the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds; they are higher than you.

entries.title: Job 35:6
segments: If you sin, what do you do against Him? Or [if] your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to Him?

entries.title: Job 35:7
segments: If you are righteous, what do you give Him? Or what does He receive from your hand?

entries.title: Job 35:8
segments: Your wickedness [may hurt] a man like yourself; and your righteousness [may profit] the son of man.

entries.title: Job 35:9
segments: From the host of tyrannies they cry out; they cry out because of the arm of the multitude.

entries.title: Job 35:10
segments: But none says, Where [is] God my Maker, who gives songs in the night;

entries.title: Job 35:11
segments: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the heavens?

entries.title: Job 35:12
segments: There they cry, but He gives no answer, because of the pride of evildoers.

entries.title: Job 35:13
segments: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty look on it.

entries.title: Job 35:14
segments: How [much less] when you say you do not see Him! Judgment [is] before Him; you are waiting for Him.

entries.title: Job 35:15
segments: And now, because His anger has not visited, and He does not recognize stupidity,

entries.title: Job 35:16
segments: even Job opens his mouth in vanity; he multiplies words without knowledge.
